evidence.explanation: For normal successful special-level loading, C create_des_coder precedes load_lua and each selected API guard is then a no-op. JS creates the coder once before registering the public des API and shares that environment. Six missing direct guard edges are one initialization-delegation cause, not missing initialization.
evidence.proof: Source hashes/order checks pin C load_special and six guards, plus JS constructor initialization before API registration. Exact C create_des_coder runs6 times with an initialized coder:0 initializer calls and unchanged pointer/marker. Production JS level_flags,level_init,terrain,wall_property,exclusion,teleport_region sequence preserves deliberately set rndmongen0/deathdrops0/temperature-1 after every call.
evidence.control: C null-coder control invokes an initializer-interface adapter once and retains its pointer on repeat. Two fresh JS loader controls each observe default rndmongen1/deathdrops1/temperature0. Adapter tests guard dispatch, not C allocation or initializer contents. Scope excludes resets, finalization/reentrancy, failed allocation, direct private env injection, other APIs and general metadata equivalence.
